gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Blockletter has a tall, belly-heavy middle, drawn as if with a pencil that never presses harder. Mochiy Pop One follows with huge lowercase eyes, and over a full page its plain sans letters hang steadily like laundry on a line.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-mochiy-pop-p-o: Blockletter brings a tall, pencil-drawn body to the heading. Mochiy Pop P One lets a longer read breathe, its plain sans letters spaced generously apart with large lowercase and no brush-like swelling.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-montserrat-und: Precise and modern, Blockletter leads with a tall middle and pencil-steady lines. Montserrat Underline follows in sans-serif with oversized lowercase and breathing counters, so a slightly generous size would let those open forms show.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-mozilla-headli: Mozilla Headline reads friendly and contemporary, with big-bodied lowercase and a splayed terminal on the c, under a Blockletter heading drawn like marker tip. The precision of one meets the approachability of the other.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-mozilla-text: Precise lettering in Blockletter keeps one uninterrupted line width on every letter, set above Mozilla Text, whose tall bodies make the lowercase look bold. The sharpest quality is the flat, stencil-like heading against flared terminals.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-nata-sans: Blockletter's tall midsection, like a squat brush-pen belly, is the first thing you notice. And Nata Sans answers with a large central band and open curves, drawn with technical-pen steadiness beneath that heading's pencil weight.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-nobile: Blockletter opens with stout diagonals and uprights alike, all of one weight. Nobile then reads in a sans with minimal gap between x-height and caps, so a long passage feels tidy and open-mouthed.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-nokora: Nokora reads dark and friendly, a thick stripe of lowercase running through each line with an s that never tightens. Blockletter earns its keep big and short, its round letters as heavy as its straight ones.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-noto-kufi-arab: Noto Kufi Arabic is modern and clean, with an open, welcoming gap in the c and capitals barely above the lowercase. Blockletter's heavy round walls sit above it.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-noto-sans: Noto Sans reads with lowercase filling most of the letter height and a wide c. Under a flat, stencil-cut Blockletter heading, a long passage in this plain sans would feel contemporary and unfussy.
